description: Extract one Safety Data Sheet PDF into a normalized 16-section record (product identification, hazards, composition, first aid, transport, regulatory, and more) plus a confidence_score and warnings. Provide the PDF as file_url (a public https URL) or file_base64. Billed per document from prepaid credit (failures are not billed). Requires an API key.

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded SDS PDF bytes (use for small files).

file_url.description: Public https URL of the SDS PDF.

filename.description: Optional file name, for example acetone-sds.pdf.

include_formats.description: Also return the XML and/or CSV renderings. Omitted by default to keep results compact.

language_hint.description: Optional language hint such as en, de, fr.

name: extract_sds
title: Extract one SDS
